title: draft shapes for the engineer
description: After intent-complete the agent pre-populates `[draft]` entities, components and interfaces as engineer entry material; `shapes:draftSettled` lists every draft home.
rationale: Spec 2026-10-01 (DEFINE step 3) section 3 and decision 8: once L1 is green, the agent populates one `[draft]` core entity per `entity` statement, one `[draft]` TAC stub per surface or external-system cluster, and `[draft]` interfaces with real kinds inside each stub, so the engineer walks into a tree whose shape is honest about what is still owed. `shapes:draftSettled` already fails `[draft]` on `TAC.interfaces[].description` in 0.29.0 (the current main; the 0.29.0 tag has not been cut). This REQ extends the marker to `TAC.purpose` and `coreEntities[].description` and extends the check to list all three id forms (`<tacId>:<name>`, `<tacId>`, `TAD.entity:<name>`). `tacHasInterface`, `kindVocabulary`, the new template-marker check and the entity join apply to drafts unchanged; nothing in the draft pass can fail a product-owner check, which is the property that keeps L1 and the draft pass independent.
